title: Data handling rules
content: Data types having more than 8bits (1bytes) like word and long are identified and broken down as per follow in this document.

Multiple byte are organized as little endian convention. If data type of long having value of AABBCCDDh. Then AA is MSB, BB is USB, CC is HSB and DD is LSB. More information on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Endianness.

title: Physical Address For Inputs
content: BIOSTAMP_3S / BIOSCRIBE_3S :: Reader Port 1, 2. Switch 1. Door Sensor 1. Temper 1 ,2. GPI 1,2.

title: Physical Address For Outputs
content: Available Outputs Per controllers. Other values are RFU / invalid

title: Upload File Data (06h)
content: File must be created using 05h command first.

title: Set finger Template (0Ch)
content: Finger Template Length may be variable. And depends upon finger size setting in fppara.

title: Area Setup (1Bh)
content: RFU command. No need to implement

title: Offline Firmware Update (Verify & Start upgrade) (25h)
content: This command will Reset Device if previous commands are executed in proper sequence.  If any error was there this command will report error

title: Get finger Template (41h)
content: Read mode will get only local templates (from sd card), will not get templates from fp module. Returned data length will depend upon finger size setting in fppara. (nominally 384 bytes per finger template)

title: Delete Specific Parameters (42h)
content: This command may take time if multiple parameters are being deleted

title: Add Extended User Information (4Bh)
content: Note: This command may be expanded in future to incorporate more information.

title: Enable / Disable Ethernet Modules (F9h)
content: Upon executing this command in write mode device will reboot.

title: Recovery Report Frame (E9h)
content: Missed: not uploaded, missed transaction found during recovery
Uploaded: uploaded transaction found during recovery
Garbage: useless / corrupt transaction found during recovery
